title: [INT-02] Configure Direct Employee Delivery
description:
Implementation plan task: INT-02
Source: Employee Management ADRs 001–004 implementation plan; specification accepted October 28, 2026.

Category:
Integrations

Objective:
Create or update Intelex Employees directly from the approved Paylocity feed.

Detailed scope:
Configure Boomi’s supported EmployeeUserAccess request mapping using the supplied endpoint contract and field allowlist. Map Position Code to JobCode, employee identity to EmployeeNumber, DateOfHire to native DateHired and HomeLocationCode from INT-01. Initial creation uses IgnoreUserAccess=TRUE. Omit Groups/custom Employee fields and both business-hierarchy properties; keep both removal controls FALSE and use supplied SendEmail/other flag decisions. Preserve optional-field omission versus explicit clearing, capacities/date formats, minimum pre-start inputs and approved feed timing.

Deliverable:
Configured Direct Employee Delivery with the specified fields or behavior and local configuration checks complete.

Strict technical prerequisites:
INT-01

Blocked status:
Blocked — requires supplied Boomi payload and identity contract; Feed and service operating parameters; also awaits INT-01.

Recommended implementer role:
Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role:
Senior Consultant

Role rationale:
Direct service mapping, conditional controls and external feed handling are moderately complex integration configuration.

Acceptance criteria:
The direct request contains the supported employee-only contract with JobCode carrying Position Code.
Custom helper/checkpoint fields, Groups and hierarchy assignments are absent; date/null handling and controls match the supplied mapping.

Specification references:
Sections 1, 8.1, 10–10.2.

Assumptions and open questions:
None
